svg.aria-label: Core sample: a geological section through 5,281 GitHub contributions since Jun 2024, one rock bed per month, with merged upstream pull requests as fossils and founded repositories as crystals.
svg.metadata: author: Zaid Ali Syed; ORCID 0009-0003-4313-1510; PGP EFE9 4832 B2B9 80D9 B583 91F2 8FAA BCC1 B1AC 09E5; drawn by scripts/core_sample.py in github.com/zaidwhy/zaidwhy
svg.text: Frontispiece · Section through the account of Zaid Ali Syed
Core sample, Jun 2024 to the present
5,281 contributions laid down one month per bed. Redrawn every night from the GitHub API.
fossil: a pull request merged into someone else's public code
bed thickness grows with the square root of contributions
